turns.prompt: I fly across time zones. Move Thursday’s run to 6:30 PM home time, which is 3:30 PM destination time. Which timezone does this sample calendar use? Do not prepare changes yet.
turns.text:
This sample calendar has no defined home or destination time zone; its times are timezone-free local labels.

For this week, please choose one consistent convention—**home time** or **destination local time**—for every session. Once you choose, I can discuss moving Thursday’s run using that clock, but I won’t prepare any change yet.
